specificFixes: S07-v2 lengthened only supporting shin to restore forefoot contact from high dangling v1.

residuals: Existing S07 andS12 upperbody scale differs from neighboring source frames; these are source characteristics, not new forced global resizing.
S04-to05 and06-to07 projected contact depth should be checked in full animation; this report does not convert static image review into dynamic acceptance.
Contact judged from foot top/forefoot edge and connected load-bearing leg, not bottommost pixel alone; no uniform contact-y across perspective depth is required.
